title: Cross-area coverage index
description: coverage/index.json: one entry per top-level content area, each with a maturity grade, a summary, the headline gaps, and pointers to the file where that area tracks its own gaps in detail. The detail stays with its area; this file is the rollup. __tests__/coverage.test.ts asserts the area list matches the live top-level content directories and that every pointer resolves.

maturity_grades.description: What each grade means; every grade used in areas[] is defined here.

id.description: The top-level directory name the entry summarizes.

summary.description: Qualitative maturity summary. Counts live in the detail sources, where they are computed, not here.

detail.description: Where the area tracks its own gaps in full. Repo-relative paths; each must exist.
